text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A sudden clamor on the streets catches {0}'s attention.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}が散歩していると、
急に街全体が騒がしくなった。

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text:
It's a monster!
There's a wild monster right on the edge of town!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物だ！
街のすぐ近くに、
凶暴な魔物が来てるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Resident 2
text_block_list.text:
What're we gonna do? If we let it be,
there's no telling what it'll do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうするんじゃ？
放っておいたら、
何するかわからんぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to kill it. If we all fight together, we should be
able to take it down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
退治するしかねぇ！
みんなで協力すれば、
倒せるだろ！

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text: All right, everyone! Let's do this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし！
みんな、
行くぞー！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: SKRRREEE!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text:
That thing's incredibly ferocious.
It's gonna take all of us fighting together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつが凶暴な魔物だな！
みんなでやっつけてやる！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Please, wait!
This little one doesn't mean us any harm!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってください！
この子に敵意はありません！

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text:
How do you know?
You do realize it's a monster, right?
It could strike at any moment!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで、そんなことがわかる？
そいつは魔物だぞ！
いつ襲ってくるか、わからねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text: It's a danger to everyone, including you. Now get away from it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
危険だから、
魔物から離れるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I will not!
If you intend to attack this poor creature,
I'll do whatever I have to to protect it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
嫌です！
あなたたちが、この子を攻撃する気なら、
私が全力で止めます！

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text: H-hey, what should we do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、おい。
どうするんだ？

text_block_list.name: Resident 2
text_block_list.text:
Lost your nerve, sonny? We can't let a violent, ferocious
beast like that wander around here. There's no option
but to kill it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうするって……
凶暴な魔物がこんな所にいたら危険じゃ。
倒すしかないじゃろ。

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text:
Sorry lady, but we'll get you out of the way by force
if we have to. C'mon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのお嬢さんには悪いが、
邪魔するなら、
力ずくでどいてもらうだけだ！
いくぞ！

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text:
What is it, kid?
You gonna get in our way, too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、小僧！？
お前まで邪魔する気か？

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
If it was gonna attack someone, it would've started
with the woman, since she's closest to it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに？
魔物に敵意があるなら、
近くにいるあのお嬢さんがまっさきに襲われてる……？

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text:
Y-you have a point... But still, we can't just let it roam
around this close to town!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
たしかに一理あるが……
しかし、
街の近くにいられたら困るんだ！

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text:
Chase it away? All right, have it your way.
If you can actually do that, then we won't kill it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
遠ざける、
だと？
……
いいだろう。
本当にそんなことができるなら、
退治はしないでやる。

text_block_list.name: Resident 1
text_block_list.text:
That's the better option all around.
Now we won't have to fight, either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たちとしても、
戦わないで済むなら、
その方がいいしな。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring it back to the forest! I promise, I'll do whatever
I have to to keep it safe and unharmed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私がこの子を森に返してきます！
この子を傷つけないためなら、
なんでもします！

text_block_list.name: Resident 2
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
It's all yours, young lady.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかった。
じゃあ、
その魔物はお嬢さんに任せたぞ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
And thank you too, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます！
{0}君もありがとうね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You'll help me? I really appreciate this.
Let's go, shall we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
手伝ってくれるの？
ありがとう。
それじゃあ一緒に行きましょ。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GROOOAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hmm?
Why did I protect this little one?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
どうしてこの子をかばっていたのかって？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Actually, I found it caught in a monster trap.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……この子ね、
前に魔物用のトラップにかかっていたの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
It was injured and in pain.
I couldn't abandon it just because it happens to be a monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
傷ついて苦しんでて……
魔物だからって放っておけなくて。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: So I freed it from the trap and healed its wounds.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからトラップを解除して、
治療しちゃったの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
And apparently it took a liking to me.
It must've wandered all the way to the edge of town
trying to find me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしたら、なつかれちゃったみたい。
きょうも私を探して、街まで来ちゃったのよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
See? Notice how docile it's being while following us?
You can tell it's a kind, sweet little monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
いまも大人しくついて来てくれてるでしょ？
この子はとっても優しい魔物なの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
By the way, {0}.
Why did you believe me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも
{0}君、
どうして私のこと信じてくれたの？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
It might've only been a coincidence that it wasn't
attacking me at the time.
choice_data_list: It didn't look like it meant any harm.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私が襲われていないのも、
この子の気まぐれだったかもしれないのに……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Right? You have a talent for looking at things
from multiple viewpoints. Impressive, like usual.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうでしょ？
さすが{0}君。
見る目が違うわね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hee hee. I'm happy that you trust me so much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
私のこと信頼してくれてるんだ。
うれしいな～

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GROOOAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to your faith in my judgment,
this little one got home alive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君が信じてくれたおかげで、
この子も退治されないで済んだわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Once again, you came to my rescue.
And once again, all I can say is thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
また助けられちゃったわね。
いつもありがとうね。
